title: The Samsung Galaxy Watch9 Wants to Tell You Everything About Your Body
summary: This past summer, Samsung launched the Galaxy Watch9 alongside the Galaxy Watch Ultra2, its more rugged, shock-resistant smartwatch for outdoor adventures. The Watch9 also carries over many of Samsung’s existing health features.
